description: This file defines the AndroidGradleBuildTarget class, which extends BuildTarget, representing a build target for Android Gradle projects within the IntelliJ IDEA JPS build system. It includes nested classes for target type and root descriptor, and manages project-specific build configurations.

classes.name: AndroidGradleBuildTarget
classes.description: Represents a build target for Android Gradle projects, extending BuildTarget with project-specific configurations and dependencies.

classes.name: AndroidGradleBuildTarget.TargetType
classes.description: Defines the type of the AndroidGradleBuildTarget, including methods to compute all targets and create loaders.

classes.name: AndroidGradleBuildTarget.RootDescriptor
classes.description: Describes the root directory for the build target.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this build target.

methods.name: computeDependencies
methods.description: Computes dependencies for this build target, returns empty list.

methods.name: computeRootDescriptors
methods.description: Computes root descriptors, returns empty list.

methods.name: findRootDescriptor
methods.description: Finds a root descriptor by rootId.

methods.name: getPresentableName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the build target.

methods.name: getOutputRoots
methods.description: Returns output root files, empty list.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on project.
